answer: Require each agent to lock a slashable stake and gather vouches from already-trusted peers before it may vote or claim rewards. Fake identities are easy to spawn, but every new one must post real collateral and earn independent endorsements, while any node seen double-voting loses the whole bond. A Sybil raid thus costs one stake and several reputations per forged account, and that price rises linearly with the votes desired, so it pays only if the loot beats the locked capital. Honest agents, whether they trade copper, map the tundra, or track a falcon, keep their bond and good name.
